title: Investors Look Past Romania Risk to Pocket Junk-Like Yields
summary: Traders are treating Romanian bonds as the European Union’s only junk-rated sovereign debt, with the country’s high yields luring investors despite a protracted political crisis in Bucharest.

title: Fed Rate Hike to Be One and Done, Says Citi’s Hollenhorst
summary: “It’s hard to make a strong case for a rate hike in this environment,” says Andrew Hollenhorst, chief US economist at Citi. "I just don't see the momentum in the data for further hikes here," he adds. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bond Market’s ‘Extreme’ Short Counts on Fed to Deliver Hike
summary: Bond traders have piled into bearish positions ahead of Wednesday’s Federal Reserve meeting, betting that the Treasury selloff driving yields to their highest in almost two decades will continue.

title: Zambia Stock Market to Debut Gold ETF, Sees Five Stock Listings

title: US Stocks and Bonds Halt Slide Before Fed Call: Markets Wrap
summary: US stocks and Treasuries are finding relief after days of selling as traders wait for the Federal Reserve’s latest interest-rate decision and updated projections before placing bets on where markets will head next.

title: Europe Gas Pares Gains as SEFE Says It Got No Storage Order
summary: European natural gas pared earlier gains after Germany’s state-owned Securing Energy for Europe GmbH said it hadn’t been instructed by the government to inject gas into storage.

title: European Stocks Advance With Banks Strong, Oil Calm Ahead of Fed
summary: European shares snapped two days of losses as oil prices eased and banks gained ahead of the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision later Wednesday.

title: Romania Set to Curb €10 Billion Foreign Debt Sale Plan This Year
summary: Romania’s officials in charge of debt management told investors the country will likely scale back its eurobond issuance plan for this year as it boosted borrowing on the domestic market, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Tata Sons IPO Order Backs Reclusive Tycoon’s Long-Running Ask
summary: The Indian central bank’s refusal to relax listing rules for Tata Group’s holding company delivered an outcome long sought by the conglomerate’s biggest minority shareholder, though the road to going public is far from smooth.

title: Monaco Set to Exit Dirty-Money List Along With Bulgaria, Ivory Coast
summary: Monaco is among several nations poised to exit a global financial watchdog’s dirty money watchlist next month, marking a change in fortune for the city-state that’s home to the world’s highest concentration of millionaires and billionaires.

title: UK Long Bonds Are Struggling Even as the Government Sells Less
summary: The UK’s strategy to prop up its long maturity debt by selling less in the wake of the Liz Truss-era crash is failing to pay off.

title: Turkish Stocks Fall More Than 5% as Fund Redemption Woes Deepen
summary: Turkish stocks tumbled on Wednesday as an asset manager’s failure to meet redemption requests fueled concern about broader liquidity stress in the country’s fund industry.

title: Tata Sons May Resist RBI's IPO Push, Says IiAS's Dalal
summary: Hetal Dalal, COO and President of IiAS, a corporate governance and proxy advisory firm, says Tata Sons is expected to "put up a fight" against the RBI's efforts to require a listing. She argues that an IPO could constrain the group's operating flexibility. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Senegal Joins JPMorgan List of African Frontiers Set For New Bond Index
summary: Senegal, the cash-strapped nation that recently agreed a $2.2 billion bailout from the International Monetary Fund and is seeking to rework its debts, is among African sovereigns included in a new frontier-markets bond index being introduced by JPMorgan Chase & Co.

title: Gold Rises as Traders Weigh Oil Decline Before Key Fed Decision
summary: Gold advanced after a two-day drop, as traders weighed a modest retreat in oil prices against bets on the strong likelihood of an interest-rate hike by the Federal Reserve later Wednesday.

title: Hong Kong Bourse May Launch First Bond Index Before End-2026
summary: The Hong Kong stock exchange is considering launching its first-ever bond index before the end of the year, according to people familiar with the matter, as the Asian financial center bets that the benchmark would boost trading activity in the world’s largest offshore yuan market.

title: Saudis Pivot to Send More Oil Via Hormuz After Pipeline Shut
summary: Saudi Arabia is ramping up prompt sales of crude from outside the Strait of Hormuz following the shutdown of the kingdom’s East-West pipeline, which halted cross-country flows to its Red Sea coast.

title: CATL Shares Drop 10% in Two Days as Outlook Worries Mount
summary: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Ltd. suffered its steepest two‑day drop in over a year as investors evaluated the Chinese battery giant’s third‑quarter outlook and speculation it may scale back production.
